title: Fix Avahi not working due to systemd-resolved mDNS conflict
summary: If Avahi fails to resolve .local hostnames or services, it might be because systemd-resolved's built-in mDNS is interfering. You need to disable systemd-resolved's mDNS or switch to the full mdns NSS module.
error_patterns: nss-mdns does not seem to forward requests

steps.explain: Check if your DNS server returns NXDOMAIN for the 'local' domain. If it does not, systemd-resolved is likely interfering.
steps.expect: If it returns something other than NXDOMAIN, proceed to the next step.

steps.explain: Edit /etc/nsswitch.conf to use the full 'mdns' module instead of 'mdns_minimal'. Change the hosts line to include 'mdns [NOTFOUND=return]'.
Create /etc/mdns.allow and add '.local.' and '.local' to it to restrict Avahi to the local domain.

warnings: Using the full mdns module can break reverse lookups in tools like mtr and traceroute.
Ensure you have a backup of /etc/nsswitch.conf before editing.
